Name: Prismatic Furniture
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod, you can create a Content Patcher pack that points to a png file with a partial or full furniture texture and that texture will be drawn as prismatic when drawing the associated furniture.

An example content.json file:

[code]﻿{
    "Format": "1.25.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "Load",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.PrismaticBed",
            "FromFile": "assets/bed.png"
        },
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.PrismaticFurniture/dictionary",
            "Entries": {
                "Bed": {
                    "id": "Bed",
                    "texturePath": "aedenthorn.PrismaticBed",
                    "speed":2
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}
[/code]
[b]"speed"[/b] refers to how fast color shifting occurs. The entry keys should be the name of the furniture (not the display name).

You can also set a decimal [b]"offset"[/b], to start the shifting on a different color, though I haven't tested to see how that works.

The png file should be the same size as the furniture source rectangle on the spritesheet, including variations (rotation, on/off, etc.).

An example pack is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12590/]here[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
